requirements.statement: The sign-in page provides a blue underlined “Forgot password?” link that starts a reset request.

requirements.statement: The response to a password-reset request is identical whether the account exists or not.
acceptance_criteria: Given one existing and one nonexistent account identifier, when otherwise equivalent reset requests are submitted, then their responses are identical and do not distinguish account existence.

requirements.statement: Reset requests are limited to five accepted requests per account per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Given a known account and a one-hour interval, when six reset requests are submitted for that account within the interval, then no more than five requests are accepted.

requirements.statement: A reset link can complete a password reset only once.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid reset link has completed a reset, when the same link is used again, then it cannot complete another reset.

requirements.statement: A reset link expires 30 minutes after issuance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset link issued at a known time, when it is used at least 30 minutes after issuance, then it cannot complete a reset.

requirements.statement: Completing a valid reset changes the synthetic account's password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a synthetic account and its valid unused unexpired reset link, when the owner completes the reset with a new password, then the account's password changes to the new password.

requirements.statement: Completing a password reset signs the account out of every active session.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account with multiple active sessions represented by the application, when its password reset completes, then none of those sessions remains signed in.

requirements.statement: Every successful password reset notifies the account owner.
acceptance_criteria: Given a synthetic account, when a password reset succeeds, then a notification addressed to its owner is captured after the reset in the in-memory sink.

requirements.statement: The application uses synthetic accounts rather than real customer accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application is run, when its account data is inspected, then the accounts used are synthetic, not real customer identities.

requirements.statement: The application captures its notifications in an in-memory notification sink.
